title: Hosted acceptance dispatch exceeded GitHub's 25-input limit and invalidated its reviewed workflow pin
auth_mode: guest/member/admin; dispatch failure independent of sign-in
reproduction: Run node --test scripts/hosted-notes-startup-diagnostic-route.test.mjs and observe the workflow_dispatch top-level input count assertion fail at 26 > 25.
Run node --test scripts/hosted-remote-admission.test.mjs and observe HOSTED_WORKFLOW_BLOB_UNREVIEWED because the workflow changed without refreshing its reviewed SHA pin.
Inspect the requested_by input and run-name change introduced in commit 110b991a9; the input count was already 25 before that change.
expected: The hosted workflow keeps no more than 25 dispatch inputs, retains requested_by attribution, and the exact workflow bytes pass the reviewed admission contract.
actual: The extra requested_by field raised the dispatch to 26 inputs; the previous SHA pin also rejected the workflow. Exact-main CI 38213966412 and focused acceptance 38213966425 failed. Existing dispatch planners omitted requested_by and exact run-name verification would reject a newly attributed run.
cause: CI spend attribution was added as a new workflow_dispatch input without consolidating an existing diagnostic input, refreshing the workflow admission pin, or updating the dispatch/verification contract.
severity: S2: hosted browser acceptance and main CI are unavailable; this is infrastructure failure, not a product behavior result
priority: P0: restore the guarded acceptance route before further hosted product testing or release gating
source_repair: The mutually exclusive SEO resource and controlled-interruption diagnostics now share one choice input. requested_by remains and all guarded dispatch planners send the stabilization lane; the verifier accepts exact attributed route names while preserving earlier evidence. The reviewed SHA pin matches the 25-input workflow. The macOS-only resource integration job has an explicit documented cost-guard exception in this public repository, and the contributed cost manifest was formatted for the mandatory lint gate. Focused admission, Notes and SEO tests passed 54/54 before the final narrow test additions; an independent peer found no valid route loss. Exact-main focused acceptance CI 38215491147 and full CI 38215491148 passed at source 2c7cf7e06. No actual hosted dispatch retest has run.
next_action: Run one permitted guarded hosted dispatch against the repaired exact-main workflow, then independently check the original admission/input-cap and surrounding routes before closure. The cross-repo CI spend guard still reports aidream at about $250 billed/week against the $100 ceiling; do not bypass or dispatch a paid job. Do not count infrastructure source tests as product acceptance.
